addons.name: Jellyfin
addons.author: Korie
addons.description: Films and series from your own Jellyfin server, played in Korie's player. Finds the server on your network or takes its address, signs in with Quick Connect or a password, and keeps one sign-in per Korie profile so everyone has their own Continue Watching.

addons.name: Open Films
addons.author: Korie
addons.description: Two free films from the Blender Foundation (CC BY), streamed from download.blender.org and played in Korie's own player, with Resume. Also the smallest example of a Korie add-on.

addons.name: Radio
addons.author: Korie
addons.description: Internet radio by country, from the free Radio Browser directory. Its own Radio tile on Home and section in Korie TV, stations in Search, and they play in the background with the now-playing pill on Home.

addons.name: ZeroPlay
addons.author: MightyX3N
addons.description: Your Xbox through ZeroPlay: an Xbox tile on Home and an Xbox section in Korie TV with your installed games and their covers, recently played games in the carousel and in Search. Play starts the game and opens ZeroPlay full screen to stream it (Home keeps the stream running in the background); Start on Xbox starts it on the console for the TV it is connected to. Finds ZeroPlay on your network and signs in with a ZeroPlay profile.
